Blâmant les soulèvements populaires causées par les mêmes abus que dans la jeunesse d’Ernst Moritz Arndt, des soldats ont été envoyés, les rebelles incarcérés; Les paysans cherchèrent vengeance de cela, menacèrent plusieurs nobles et les abattirent.

Während die Justiz den Putschversuch vom 6. Januar 2021 aufarbeitet und immer mehr Aufrührer verurteilt, stellt der republikanische Präsidentschaftskandidat Ron DeSantis zahlreiche Begnadigungen in Aussicht. examples.translation: Alors que la justice travaille sur la tentative de coup d'État du 6 janvier 2021 et condamne de plus en plus d'émeutiers, le candidat républicain à la présidence Ron DeSantis promet de nombreuses grâces. Il suit l’exemple de Donald Trump qui transforme les auteurs de violences en héros patriotiques.

glosses: A person who provokes or takes part in an insurrection.

examples.text: Defining the mostly white crowd that stormed the Capitol on January 6 as “insurrectionists” does more than set a narrative mood, it represents a major narrative shift—expanding the traditional role of the insurrectionist beyond the Black actor to the white one.

glosses: Involved in or characterized by insurrection.

examples.text: The atmosphere was undeniably insurrectionist in nature, yet the police response was languid to the extent that one woman asked an officer when they would be leaving because "they have to fix up."

glosses: A person who resists an established authority, often violently.

examples.text: My little sister is such a rebel - coming home late, piercing her ears, and refusing to do any of her chores.
A group of rebels defied the general's orders and split off from the main army.

glosses: Synonym of Confederate: a citizen of the Confederate States of America, especially a Confederate soldier.

examples.text: to rebel against the system
"Tedd's feeling a bit rebellious." "I'm not rebelling! I'm self actualizing! By rebelling."

glosses: To forcefully subvert the law of the land in an attempt to replace it with another form of government.

examples.text: The rioters had erected a makeshift barricade and were pelting the police with rocks from behind it.
